interest: British-forced arrests of Axis suspects in Iran, 1942.
overview: April 1942 telegrams on the arrest of six Iranians accused of Axis work for the Japanese Legation, demanded by the British.

people.name: Harold B. Minor
people.role: American diplomat / Chargé d'Affaires at Tehran

people.name: Hesam-ed-Din Ghaffari
people.role: Employee of Japanese Legation and active Axis agent

people.name: Sarem-ed-Din Zolfaghari
people.role: High official of Ministry of Health (General / Colonel)

people.name: Reza Qoli Tabataba'i
people.role: General, brother-in-law of the Shah, and head of Army Health Department

subfiles.about: Inquiry regarding press and Axis radio reports concerning the arrest of six prominent Iranians suspected of Axis subversion under the direction of the Japanese Legation.
subfiles.summary: Welles asks Tehran to verify reports that six Iranians were arrested for Axis activity under the Japanese Legation.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Welles to American Legation in Tehran on Reported Arrests of Axis Agents

subfiles.about: Detailed report on British-instigated arrests of prominent Iranians accused of pro-German activities, their planned internment in Ahwaz, and domestic political fallout.
subfiles.summary: Minor reports the arrests were demanded by the British, who moved the six to Ahwaz; evidence was circumstantial.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 111 from Minor (Tehran) to Secretary of State on British-Instigated Arrests and Exile to Ahwaz
